raw_segments.text: Time, however, continued to advance, and the Anglo-Americans, spreading beyond the coasts
of the Atlantic Ocean, penetrated farther and farther into the solitudes of the West.
They met with a new soil and an unwanted climate.
The obstacles which opposed them were of the most various character, their races intermingled,
the inhabitants of the South went up towards the North, those of the North descended to
But in the midst of all these causes, the same result occurred at every step, and in
general the colonies in which there were no slaves became more populous and more rich
than those in which slavery flourished.
The more progress was made, the more was it shown that slavery, which is so cruel to the
South, is prejudicial to the Master.
